obligations.description: Review sigma-framework architecture, dependency boundaries, invariants and obligation-to-implementation mapping without delegating closure to scripts.
Perform an obligation-by-obligation adversarial review, including negative cases and accidental-complexity inspection.
Run representative scaling/resource measurements and record time, peak memory, allocations/copies and empirical scaling; compilation alone is not performance certification.
Manually reconcile planned obligations against implementation and executable evidence before declaring a campaign or release closed.
Run Python lint and correctness checks.
Run property, mutation and hostile-input campaigns and inspect failures manually; do not infer cryptographic security from test success.
Reconcile optimized and experimental implementations with frozen reference implementations and statistical protocols.
